scope: Vendor fixed-schema LED drawing kernel, not end-to-end Rivu performance or a completed consumer migration
baseline: Current SpectrumStyle::Led append_rect -> NonZero PathBuilder tessellation -> textured Path -> WGPU intermediate rasterization; unchanged old rendering path used in the same executable
candidate: GPU rectangle instances and fragment segmentation with complete dynamic publication

environment.process_headless_device_cache: One device is shared across renderer recreations; driver shader cache is not cleared

workload.palette: 1024-sample 8-bit-quantized Tokyo Night cubic Hermite curve; same samples for both paths; candidate represents samples as f32 RGBA
workload.order: Alternating Path/instances and instances/Path by run
workload.cpu_update: After common signal input generation; old path contour construction+tessellation+scene recording versus complete candidate publication (and placement rerecord on resize)
workload.render_readback: WgpuHeadlessRenderer::render_scene_to_image wall time: CPU preparation, submission, GPU completion, texture readback and image assembly; not isolated GPU execution time
workload.memory_measurement: Independent process per route and repetition, os.wait4 ru_maxrss in KiB; all four workloads; not isolated VRAM

derived_payload_bytes.accounting: Derived from actual initial tessellated vertex counts and tested 144-byte PathRasterizationVertex, 16-byte PathSprite, 32-byte Rectangle, 16-byte palette sample and 80-byte Placement layouts; excludes common globals, texture allocation, padding outside records, staging and driver overhead

limits: No GPU timestamp-query timing or isolated VRAM measurement
No full-player frame-rate or audio-system performance claim
Five renderer-first-draw samples are not five cold driver-cache samples
Placement uniforms still allocate per prepared draw; a publication still uploads its complete palette
Workstation background activity and thermal state are not controlled
Original first_draw_readback_us omits initial CPU preparation and is not complete first-use latency; use first_use_supplement for that comparison

first_use_supplement.purpose: Close missing initial CPU preparation and asymmetrical device initialization in earlier renderer-first-draw observations
first_use_supplement.method: Five fresh processes per route, alternating route order by repetition; one renderer and one first draw per process; same 96-column 768x320 LED workload, 1024-sample palette, 3/2px cells; release thin-LTO profile; selected AMD Radeon 780M RADV Vulkan
first_use_supplement.constructor_us: Includes first headless device creation and existing GPUI pipeline construction, measured separately for each fresh process
first_use_supplement.initial_prepare_us: Path: palette packing/admission/upload scheduling, contours, tessellation, scaling, scene insertion/sort; instances: frame validation/copy, dynamic state creation, scene insertion/sort
first_use_supplement.first_render_readback_us: Includes lazy rectangle program creation in candidate, upload, rendering, completion and readback for both routes
first_use_supplement.total_us: Measured wall time from before renderer creation through completed first image; includes all three phases, excluding common normalized input and cubic palette sample generation
caveats: Driver shader cache not cleared; fresh process/device is not cold driver-cache performance
Earlier steady-state runs remain historical data at their recorded source hashes; this supplement does not silently overwrite or relabel those samples
Stage medians need not sum to the median of total wall time

unified_material_slice.scope: Vendor-only closed rectangle/field/path material API; color-first field only; no application consumer migration

workload.order: baseline then candidate on even runs; reversed on odd runs
workload.field_mapping: clamp((10*log10(value)+70)/70,0,1); nearest palette floor(coord*255+0.5), then bilinear colors
workload.input: x=(i%side)/side; y=(i/side)/side; zero when floor((i%side)/8)==3, otherwise 10^(-7*abs(sin(3*x+0.2*phase)*y))
workload.palette: 256 straight RGBA samples [t,1-t,0.3,round(sqrt(t)*255)/255], t=i/255; baseline converted to BGRA8 once
workload.path: 1024 points, 2px stroke; start (2,160), then (2+i*764/1023,160+145*sin(0.015*i+0.1*phase)); 768x320 output; identical existing tessellation, textured path vs GpuFrame::path
workload.exclusions: Common input/geometry generation and shared palette fixture creation; image retirement after completed readback is outside CPU-update timer; no producer work in static loops
workload.timing_boundary: CPU publication/scene update separately from renderer preparation, submit, completion, image readback and assembly; not GPU timestamps
workload.initial_phases: In-process diagnostic phases only; device and driver caches not reset; not a cold-start comparison

derived_payload_bytes.note: Logical encoded bytes, not measured bus traffic or physical VRAM; conservative buffer admission charges two copies; existing path intermediate textures are outside this extension buffer budget

native_surface.route: nested niri on headless Weston GL; GPUI selected Vulkan
native_surface.input: Wayland virtual pointer, press/release through compositor
observed: phase 2 clears all three while labels remain
window width 1280->960 preserves phase 3 and right-side clipping

verification.probe_release_build: passed; existing upstream deprecated/dead-code warnings unchanged

limitations: No isolated GPU timestamps or physical VRAM measurements
Static enlarged field render/readback is slower; retain this tradeoff before consumer migration
Path material colors are not bit-identical to existing BGRA texture sampling

review_corrections.scope: Demand-local pipelines, conservative adjacent path batching, and raw state publication admission

method.process: One fresh process per revision/workload/run; alternate before/after order
method.build: Identical runtime.rs compiled with rustc --edition=2024 -C opt-level=3 -C strip=symbols; dependencies from matched release thin-LTO Cargo feature sets
method.baseline: Previously compiled pre-review rlibs, linked into before executable before rebuilding dependencies
method.placements: 56x56 integer bounds spaced 64 pixels, up to eight columns; one shared frame/palette
method.path: 2px stroke through (2,2), (50,40), (5,54), mapped into each placement; RGBA [0.8,0.1,0.3,0.65], draw opacity 0.8
method.field: 256x256 identical 0.2 scalar cells, 70dB logarithmic mapping, one palette color
method.first_use: constructor, CPU preparation, first render/readback reported separately; first_phase_sum is their sum, not a separate wall-clock measurement; common fixture input/palette construction excluded
method.replay: 20 samples after four warmups, median per process
limits: Background load and thermal state not controlled
No claim of universal end-to-end startup improvement
bench-support exposes headless observation only; not a production feature or a11y dependency

wgpu_initial_suite.failure: new fixture incorrectly used zero field/path capacities

verification.comparison_assertion: exact raw-image equality in four batch/individual cases
verification.production_change_for_fixture_failure: none; only explicit fixture capacities corrected
